newsitem.title: UK: Japanese Stocks in London firmer, await FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Japanese Stocks in London firmer, await FOMC.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were unchanged to slightly firmer on Tuesday as investors sat on the sidelines and awaited the outcome of the two day U.S. FOMC meeting which starts today, dealers said.
The Nikkei/ISE 50 index crept up 4.98 points to 1,619.57 in low turnover.
Earlier in Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 index fell 429.44 to 20,175.52, depressed by anxiety over the Nomura Securities Co Ltd scandal and apprehension ahead of the policy-setting FOMC meeting.
"Basically, the market lacks a theme," said one dealer. "Investors are waiting for the scandals finish and for some direction from the FOMC."
Dealers said turnover had been concentrated in blue chip stocks.
Fujitsu stood out as it eased five yen to 1555 yen, bucking the generally firmer trend. Dealers attributed Fujitsu's slide to weakness in the dollar.
